Noting that this user already has a thread for this idea here: http://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/forum/t-13894324/reality-bender-virus-idea-need-help

deus_ex_machina99, as stated in the Required Reading, do not create a new thread for a concept already on the forum, unless the thread has not been posted on in 14 days or longer. If you wish to make changes to your concept, please edit the original thread instead of creating a new one.

item.title: antimemetic virus
item.content:encoded:
greenlight: no

genre/theme: horror/comedy

elevator pitch: An anomalous strain of Yersinia Pestis, anyone who describes it as a virus develops it. however, whenever someone develops it, it spreads into a "body horror" virus. For examples affected may develop tendrils, [REDACTED], Rouge ████, and other sorts of mishaps and abominations.

central narrative: the person, assigned SCP-XXXX-1, develops an extreme social urge to talk to his/her friends. however they are disgusted when they see SCP-XXXX-1's face. SCP-XXXX-1 is unaware as the virus as the pathogen exhibits a memetic chemical similar to Class E amnestics so SCP-XXXX-1 thinks this is what their face usually looks like. anyways its terrible feel free to use it if you want to lol
